links.outcome: Survey ratings of usability, time savings and documentation quality for the ambient scribe
links.effect: User-friendliness rated good (median 5, IQR 4-6); median time saving 16 to 30 minutes per shift; documentation quality rated lowest (69-73 respondents per item).
links.quote: Survey respondents (69-73 per item) rated user-friendliness as good (median 5, IQR 4-6), reported a median time saving of 16 to 30 (IQR 0-15 to 46-60) minutes per shift, and rated documentation quality the lowest.

unlisted_practices: Deploying an open-source, in-house AI scribe entirely within institutional infrastructure to preserve data sovereignty and lower operating cost

screen.reason: An implementation report evaluating the real-world deployment, utilization, cost, and clinician satisfaction of an in-house/open-source ambient AI scribe across a provincial health system.
